name: very_short_ambiguous
description: Tests the AI's ability to handle a very short ambiguous message and ask for clarification about what kind of boards the user needs

expected_behaviors.description: AI should ask the user to specify what type of boards they need (melamine, MDF, supawood, etc.)

notes: Very short ambiguous message. The AI should not assume a specific product but should ask the user to clarify which type of boards they are interested in (melamine, MDF, supawood, plywood, etc.) and what specifications they need.
